title: 单次重写足矣：生产环境技能描述优化的实证经验
summary: 针对企业AI代理中技能描述重叠导致的路由错误（技能碰撞），提出自动化描述优化流水线。在生产系统（9个技能）上达到79.2% F1，与手动调优的79.4% F1相当，但工程耗时从120分钟降至3.8分钟。消融实验表明，仅需一次LLM重写即可获得大部分改进，其他设计选择影响小于0.5%。
summary_en: Proposes an automated description optimization pipeline for enterprise AI agents to resolve skill collisions caused by overlapping descriptions. Achieves 79.2% F1 matching manual tuning (79.4% F1) while reducing engineering effort from 120 to 3.8 minutes per skill. Ablation shows a single LLM rewrite captures most improvement; other design choices affect F1 by <0.5%.
